caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless vest, rendered in grayish tones with detailed and colorful embroidery throughout. The vest features a row of black buttons down the center front, flanked by symmetrical floral decorations incorporating pink, red, and yellow roses, purple flowers, green leaves, and small blue star-like shapes scattered over the entire vest. The neckline and the edges are bordered with a thin red line, with elaborate floral patterns concentrated particularly around the pockets, hem, and along the button placket. The vest includes two pointed pocket flaps or decorative extensions near the bottom on either side, heavily adorned with the same intricate floral embroidery as found throughout the garment. The background of the image is a plain light beige.
title: Silk Vest
